newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sept S&P 500s hold huge gains, off peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sept S&P 500s hold huge gains, off peaks.

text.p: June 12 - U.S. Sept S&P 500 futures held huge gains, off day's and record peaks. Brokers said futures rally occurred on huge fund buying that some said looked like new longs. Some cited technicals after last week's breakout, psychology of being close to 900.00 cash S&Ps, gains in T-bond futures and weak US retail sales that quelled rate-hike talk, as behind rally.
